SELECT
  s.store_id,
  s.store_name,
  SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts,
  SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.calendar_date >= DATE '2025-05-26'
  AND d.calendar_date <= DATE '2025-06-22'
  AND s.store_id < 900
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name
ORDER BY net_sales DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT store_id) as store_count
FROM dim_store
WHERE is_current = TRUE AND store_id < 900

SELECT
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(f.net_amount) DESC) AS rank,
  s.store_id,
  s.store_name,
  ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount), 2) AS net_sales,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts,
  SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.calendar_date >= DATE '2025-05-26'
  AND d.calendar_date <= DATE '2025-06-22'
  AND s.store_id < 900
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name
ORDER BY net_sales DESC

SELECT store_id, closure_type, closure_start_date, closure_end_date
FROM ref_store_closure
WHERE closure_start_date <= DATE '2025-06-22' AND closure_end_date >= DATE '2025-05-26'
ORDER BY store_id

SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN channel_code = 'ST' THEN receipt_id END) as store_receipts,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN channel_code = 'WB' THEN receipt_id END) as web_receipts,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN channel_code = 'ST' THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) as store_sales,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN channel_code = 'WB' THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) as web_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.calendar_date >= DATE '2025-05-26' AND d.calendar_date <= DATE '2025-06-22'
